faq.callUs: Your question not listed? Feel free to call us.

price.title: A fair price, <muted>in your inbox within 24 hours.</muted>
price.body: A real person on our team looks at your request. What you see in the quote is what you pay — no surprises afterwards.

safe.title: 1 · Safety first
items: Pull the car over as safely as possible and switch on the hazard lights.
Put on a high-visibility vest and place the warning triangle.
Wait behind the guardrail, not in or next to the car.

call.title: 2 · Call us
items: Give the exact location (street, exit or kilometre marker).
Tell us which vehicle it is and what is wrong.
Say where the car needs to go.

come.title: 3 · We come
items: You immediately get an honest answer about when we can be there.
We load the car safely using the winch.
We take it to your garage, to your home or to our depot.

overview.label: Overview
overview.promise: A personal reply within 24 hours — from someone on our team, not from a calculator.
